- Retries: automatic for safe calls; do not wrap calls in your own retry loop. Set `ClientConfig.maxAttempts` to change the attempt limit (3, the first included; 1 turns retries off), and `timeout`, `baseDelay` and `maxDelay` for the call budget and backoff.

## A complete call: `GetCity`

```java
import example.weather.ClientConfig;
import example.weather.WeatherClient;
import example.weather.model.GetCityInput;
import example.weather.model.GetCityOutput;
import example.weather.model.NotFoundError;
import java.time.Instant;

public class GetCityExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request.
        ClientConfig config = new ClientConfig();
        config.token = () -> System.getenv("WEATHER_TOKEN");
        WeatherClient client = new WeatherClient(config);

        // Values from the model's example "Read a city".
        GetCityInput input = GetCityInput.builder()
            .cityId("c-0a1b2c3d")
            .at(Instant.parse("2026-01-02T03:04:05Z"))
            .build();

        try {
            GetCityOutput output = client.getCity(input);
            System.out.println(output.city());
            System.out.println(output.forecast());
            System.out.println(output.requestId());
        } catch (NotFoundError error) {
            System.err.println("NotFoundError (HTTP " + error.status() + "): " + error.message());
        }
    }
}
```
